clock: simulated physical seconds; host timings separate

geometry.heading: psi_world=psi_c(s)+e_psi
geometry.s: unwrapped centerline arc length; geometry uses s modulo L
geometry.frame: world XY metres, CCW radians, Frenet left positive

vis1.native_window.v1.extrema: native physical evidence including recorded terminal endpoint
vis1.native_window.v1.rms: left-held time weights over native sample intervals; angular residual wrapped
vis1.native_window.v1.variation: native adjacent differences within scope; heading wrapped
vis1.native_window.v1.crossing_duration: linear progress in recorded step bracket

null_policy: JSON null / empty CSV cell; row missing_reasons and channel_availability; absent event-type fields not_applicable
ordering: partial order only; same-time loop continuations cannot be globally ranked from these logs
